_meta.purpose: Performance Verification Device (PVD) profiles for the Vitrek V7X series.
_meta.why_not_the_built_in_routine: The V7X front panel has UTILITY MENU -> AUTO PVD, but the remote command set documented in Section 6 of the V7X Series Operating Manual has NO command to trigger it. RUN only executes the active programmed sequence. So this software reproduces the verification as a normal programmed sequence, which has the advantage of capturing the actual measured value for every point instead of just a front-panel PASS/FAIL.
_meta.how_pass_fail_works: Each point declares a nominal expected reading and a tolerance window. The step limits sent to the V7X are deliberately WIDE so the instrument does not trip out mid-step; the verdict is computed in software from the STEPRSLT? measurement against the window. Any instrument status flag (breakdown, arc, interlock, abort...) is an automatic FAIL regardless of the measured value.
_meta.baseline_required: Vitrek does not publish the internal load values of the APVD devices. Every point below therefore ships with nominal = null, which means the software will record the measurement but REFUSE to issue a PASS/FAIL. Run the profile in 'baseline' mode against a V71 that is within its calibration period, review the captured values, then promote them to nominals via POST /api/pvd/baseline/promote (or by editing this file).
_meta.tolerance_note: default_tol_pct must cover the V7X measurement accuracy PLUS the APVD load tolerance PLUS normal line/temperature variation. 10 % is a deliberately loose starting point for a go/no-go daily check. Tighten it only after you have several baseline runs to look at.
_meta.safety_note: Test voltages below are conservative defaults. Confirm the APVD-74 voltage ratings with Vitrek before raising any voltage field.
_meta.manual_reference: V7X Series Operating Manual - August 8, 2025, Sections 4, 6 and 7.

apvd-74.name: APVD-74 Performance Verification
apvd-74.description: Daily performance verification of the hipot tester using the Vitrek APVD-74 Performance Verification Device. The APVD-74 carries hipot, low-resistance and ground-bond loads; the ground-bond and insulation-resistance points below are skipped automatically on a V71, which has neither mode.

phases.name: Hipot load
instructions: Connect White Plug to HV Terminal
Connect Red & Black Plugs to CONT Terminals
Leave Red & Black Ring Lugs Disconnected
Ensure Disconnected Leads are Not Touching Anything
phases.danger: This phase applies high voltage. Confirm the safety enclosure is closed and nobody is in contact with the DUT area before continuing.

phases.name: Low resistance load
instructions: Leave White Plug connected to HV Terminal
Connect the Red & Black Ring Lugs together across the APVD low-resistance load
Ensure no other leads are touching anything
phases.danger: No high voltage is applied in this phase, but do not change any connection while a step is running.

phases.name: Ground bond load
instructions: Connect the K-2R ground bond leads to the APVD-74 GB terminals
Ensure the hipot leads are disconnected
phases.danger: High current. Keep hands clear of the GB leads.

points.name: ACW 1000 Vrms into hipot load
points.label: Leakage current
points.note: max_leakage is the WIDE instrument trip limit, not the pass criterion. The pass criterion is the nominal/tolerance window evaluated in software.

points.name: DCW 1000 V into hipot load
points.label: Leakage current
points.note: Wide trip limit; verdict computed in software.

points.name: IR 500 V into hipot load
points.label: Insulation resistance
points.note: Skipped on a V71 - that model has no IR mode. Present so this profile also works on a V73/V74.

points.name: CONT into low-resistance load
points.label: Resistance
points.note: Run CONT ZERO on the V7X with the leads shorted before baselining, so lead resistance is offset out. See APPENDIX A of the operating manual.

points.name: GB 25 A into ground bond load
points.label: Ground bond resistance
points.note: Skipped on a V71 - that model has no GB mode. Present so this profile also works on a V74/V77/V79.

apvd-7x.name: APVD-7X Performance Verification
apvd-7x.description: Hipot and low-resistance verification only. Same points as the APVD-74 profile minus the ground bond phase.
